How this editor works

Start with a template, insert a reusable section or drag a block into the canvas. Double-click text to edit, select elements to change their styles, and use Desktop, Tablet and Phone views to check your layout. Undo and redo affect canvas edits; Canvas focus hides the side panel. Save keeps the draft in your account. Preview shows your current edits. Review & publish creates a public page from the saved revision. Later edits stay private until you publish again. Unpublish removes the public page and keeps the draft.

Published pages support text, images, layout and ordinary links. Scripts, embedded apps and form submissions are disabled. Use the Storefront module for product enquiries and the main business website.

Review your public website

Anyone with the public link can see this saved page. Check your content, contact details and image rights before publishing. This creates a separate page; your main storefront remains managed in Storefront & hosting.
